lines.trans: I am here working overtime in Production Unit One today.
Hurry over here! The network is very unhappy about the two guests arguing at the gala.
We have to undo the negative impact.
Director Deng bypassed Mr Sun and specifically asked Unit One to clean this up.
Twelve Singers is halfway through its post-season tour, and Entertainment Talk airs every week.
All the background files have been sent to your inbox; look through them yourself.
I have too much on my plate, so contact Xiao Yao and Lv Yi first.
Demand that they issue a public apology in front of everyone.
Xingzi, since this happened at the gala, does that mean it was unsuccessful?
Overall it succeeded; their quarrel simply distracted attention from the red carpet.
Actually, the atmosphere on the red carpet that day was really great.
